description: Per-feed operator, contract and validity metadata for the GTFS extras layer. It was three dicts in src/build/build_gtfs_extras.py, naming this city's transport operators and contract regions inside the framework - a value about one city in code that is supposed to work for a city it has never seen.
note: Keyed by the feed prefix the raw GTFS bundles use. A city with different feeds supplies its own file; the framework reads whatever is here and names none of it.
vehicle_type_note: GTFS route_type -> the vehicle type id written to A3_route_extras.csv. These were three literals in src/build/build_gtfs_extras.py naming this city's fleet (eighth project report, 11 September 2026).
